scope: Read-only source investigation and archived flash API statuses; no startup-chain modification.

attempts.result: FES RAM bootstrap reported DRAM initialization and U-Boot download success, then USB reconnect failed.
Diagnostic attempt retaining serial monitor was rejected during raw_metadata preflight: RAW_STORAGE_GEOMETRY_SERIAL_OPEN COM19 access denied.
After closing the serial monitor and confirming the device remained in FEL, the original standard FES flow completed write, verification and reboot.

operator_observations: Device remained online in FEL for more than one minute before the successful standard retry.
The same audited DDR933 RAM loader was used.
Whole-disk readback is a separate validation step, not inferred from these API statuses.

watchdog_analysis.source_spl: RTC/FEL request path does not explicitly stop WDT before entering BootROM. This alone does not demonstrate watchdog retention across reset.
watchdog_analysis.vendor_ram_uboot: Actual loader embedded DTB at offset0xd32e8 describes WDT0x02050000, MODE0x14, key0x16aa0000 with no wdt_keep_reg. Matching SDK probe stops the watchdog before the autostart decision.
watchdog_analysis.fes1: Only the prebuilt FES1 input was available; its early watchdog behavior was not established.
watchdog_analysis.conclusion: Watchdog causation was not established. Sustained FEL residency and the successful unchanged-loader retry do not justify modifying the startup chain for this incident.

privacy: Archived status files redact the local Windows username; original files remain in private build logs.
